heading: cyRespond to the tenant’s application
daysNotice: cyYou have 28 days from the date the tribunal sent you the tenant’s application if you want to submit a response. The deadline date is written under ‘Your response’ in your case overview.
noFee: cyThere is no fee to send a response.
responseSharedWithTenant: cyWe will share your response and any attachments with the tenant and any representatives.
wantCopy: cyYou may want to have a copy of the tenant’s application with you.
viewTenantsApplication: View the tenant’s application (opens in a new tab)
showTenantsAnswers: cyWe will also show you the answers provided in their application in this response form. You can tell us if you disagree with anything, give your reasons, and upload any evidence you have.
confirmBasicDetails: cyWe will first ask you to confirm some basic details the tenant gave in their application, including:
